sentences.english: My mum makes great pancakes.
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈做的煎饼很棒。

sentences.english: I need to call my mum and tell her I'll be late for dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我需要给妈妈打个电话，告诉她我晚饭会晚点到。
sentences.scene: 晚回家前给妈妈打电话

sentences.english: When I was little, my mum used to read me a story every single night, even when she looked really tired after work.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候，妈妈每晚都会给我读故事，即使她下班后看起来特别累也坚持读。
sentences.scene: 回忆儿时妈妈每晚的陪伴

sentences.english: Dad, can we play catch?
sentences.chinese: 爸爸，我们能玩接球吗？

sentences.english: My dad taught me how to ride a bike when I was five.
sentences.chinese: 我五岁的时候爸爸教会了我骑自行车。
sentences.scene: 回忆爸爸教骑车的经历

sentences.english: I remember my dad getting up early every Saturday to make us pancakes, and the whole kitchen always smelled like vanilla and coffee.
sentences.chinese: 我记得每个周六爸爸都会早起给我们做煎饼，整个厨房总是弥漫着香草和咖啡的味道。
sentences.scene: 回忆周末爸爸的爱心早餐

sentences.english: My grandma lives with us.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶和我们住在一起。

sentences.english: We're driving to my grandma's house for Thanksgiving this year.
sentences.chinese: 今年我们要开车去奶奶家过感恩节。

sentences.english: My grandma always sneaks me a little money when I visit, even though I tell her I'm an adult now and I don't need it.
sentences.chinese: 我去看奶奶的时候，她总是偷偷塞给我一点钱，尽管我跟她说我已经是大人了不需要。
sentences.scene: 奶奶对孙辈不变的疼爱

sentences.english: My grandpa tells funny jokes.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷讲的笑话很有趣。

sentences.english: Grandpa fell asleep in his chair while watching the baseball game again.
sentences.chinese: 爷爷看棒球赛的时候又在椅子上睡着了。
sentences.scene: 家庭生活中有趣的日常一幕

sentences.english: My grandpa showed me his old photo album from when he was in the army, and I couldn't believe how young he looked in those pictures.
sentences.chinese: 爷爷给我看了他在部队时的旧相册，我简直不敢相信照片里的他看起来那么年轻。

sentences.english: My grandfather was a doctor.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父曾是一名医生。

sentences.english: My grandfather still drives at the age of eighty-two.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父八十二岁了仍然在开车。

sentences.english: My grandfather sat me down and told me stories about how he met my grandmother during a snowstorm, and it sounded just like a scene from an old movie.
sentences.chinese: 祖父让我坐下，给我讲他在一场暴风雪中如何遇见祖母的故事，听起来就像一部老电影里的场景。
sentences.scene: 听祖父讲年轻时的浪漫故事

sentences.english: My grandmother knits beautiful sweaters.
sentences.chinese: 我祖母织的毛衣很漂亮。

sentences.english: I found my grandmother's old recipe box in the attic last weekend.
sentences.chinese: 上周末我在阁楼里找到了祖母的旧食谱盒子。

sentences.english: My grandmother insists on sending me handwritten birthday cards every year, and her perfect cursive always makes me smile before I even read the message.
sentences.chinese: 祖母每年都坚持给我寄手写生日贺卡，她那娟秀的手写体总让我在看到内容之前就忍不住微笑。
sentences.scene: 每年收到祖母手写贺卡的感动

sentences.english: My mother speaks three languages.
sentences.chinese: 我母亲会说三种语言。

sentences.english: My mother always knows exactly what to say when I'm feeling down.
sentences.chinese: 我情绪低落的时候，母亲总是知道该说些什么。

sentences.english: My mother saved every single drawing I made from kindergarten through fifth grade, and she surprised me with them in a huge album on my graduation day.
sentences.chinese: 我母亲把我从幼儿园到五年级画的每一幅画都保存了下来，毕业那天她用一本巨大的相册装好送给我，给了我一个惊喜。
sentences.scene: 母亲珍藏孩子成长印记的感人举动

sentences.english: My father loves old black-and-white movies.
sentences.chinese: 我父亲喜欢黑白老电影。

sentences.english: My father picked me up from the airport at midnight without any complaints.
sentences.chinese: 我父亲半夜毫无怨言地去机场接我。
sentences.scene: 父亲深夜接机的温暖举动

sentences.english: My father worked two jobs while I was growing up, and now that I'm older, I finally understand the sacrifices he made for our family.
sentences.chinese: 在我成长的过程中父亲打了两份工，现在我长大了，终于理解了他为家庭做出的牺牲。
sentences.scene: 成年后体会父亲的不易

sentences.english: Please pass me the salt.
sentences.chinese: 请把盐递给我。

sentences.english: My brother told me there's a new burger place nearby.
sentences.chinese: 我哥哥告诉我附近新开了一家汉堡店。

sentences.english: She showed me a picture of the puppy she just adopted, and honestly, it was the cutest thing I've seen all year.
sentences.chinese: 她给我看了她刚收养的小狗照片，说实话，那是我一整年见过的最可爱的小东西。
sentences.scene: 朋友分享收养宠物的喜悦

sentences.english: My little sister loves princess dresses.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢公主裙。

sentences.english: I borrowed my sister's sweater without asking, and now she's mad at me.
sentences.chinese: 我没跟姐姐说就借穿了她的毛衣，她现在生我的气了。

sentences.english: Even though my sister and I fought all the time as kids, she's now the first person I call when something good or bad happens.
sentences.chinese: 尽管小时候我和姐姐总是吵架，但现在无论发生好事还是坏事，她都是我第一个想要打电话的人。

sentences.english: Family is everything to me.
sentences.chinese: 家庭对我来说就是一切。

sentences.english: My whole family gets together for a big dinner every Sunday.
sentences.chinese: 每个周日我们全家人都会聚在一起吃一顿大餐。

sentences.english: We didn't have much money when I was growing up, but my family always found a way to make the holidays feel special and full of joy.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候家里没什么钱，但我的家人总是有办法让节日变得特别、充满快乐。
sentences.scene: 回忆清贫但充满爱的童年

sentences.english: I have two cats at home.
sentences.chinese: 我家里有两只猫。
sentences.scene: 告诉别人家里养的宠物

sentences.english: Let's have lunch together after the meeting.
sentences.chinese: 开完会我们一起吃午饭吧。

sentences.english: I used to have a really old car that would shake whenever I drove over 50 miles an hour, but I honestly kind of miss it.
sentences.chinese: 我以前有一辆很旧的车，每次时速超过50英里就会抖，但说真的我还有点怀念它。

sentences.english: That's a really big dog.
sentences.chinese: 那真是一只大狗。

sentences.english: We need a bigger table if we're having eight people for dinner.
sentences.chinese: 如果有八个人吃饭，我们就需要一张更大的桌子。

sentences.english: I wanted to buy the big sofa, but my living room is so small that I had to pick a smaller one, and honestly, it fits the space much better.
sentences.chinese: 我本来想买那个大沙发，但我的客厅太小了，只好选了个小一点的，说实话，它更适合这个空间。

chinese_meaning: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹

sentences.english: My cousin and I are the same age.
sentences.chinese: 我表姐和我同岁。

sentences.english: I'm spending the weekend at my cousin's place in the city.
sentences.chinese: 我要去城里表弟的住处过周末。

sentences.english: My cousin taught me how to skateboard when we were little, and even though I fell a hundred times, she never got impatient with me.
sentences.chinese: 小时候表姐教我玩滑板，我摔了无数次，她却从来没有对我不耐烦。
sentences.scene: 回忆表姐耐心教玩滑板的童年

sentences.english: My brother is taller than me now.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟现在比我高了。
sentences.scene: 感叹弟弟身高超过自己

sentences.english: My brother borrowed my car and returned it with an empty tank.
sentences.chinese: 我哥哥借了我的车，还回来时油箱是空的。

sentences.english: My older brother always defended me when kids at school were mean, and I don't think I ever really thanked him enough for that.
sentences.chinese: 学校里有人欺负我的时候，哥哥总是护着我，我觉得我从没为此好好谢过他。

sentences.english: The baby just fell asleep.
sentences.chinese: 宝宝刚刚睡着了。

sentences.english: We're bringing a little gift for their new baby boy.
sentences.chinese: 我们给他们刚出生的儿子带了一份小礼物。

sentences.english: I was nervous about holding the baby at first, but the moment she grabbed my finger and smiled, I felt instantly relaxed.
sentences.chinese: 起初我很紧张不敢抱宝宝，但当她抓住我的手指并笑起来的一瞬间，我立刻就放松了。

sentences.english: My uncle lives in California.
sentences.chinese: 我叔叔住在加州。

sentences.english: My uncle is the funniest person at every family gathering.
sentences.chinese: 我舅舅是每次家庭聚会里最搞笑的人。

sentences.english: My uncle promised to take me fishing for years, and he finally showed up at six in the morning last Saturday with two fishing rods and a bag of snacks.
sentences.chinese: 舅舅答应带我钓鱼好多年了，上周六早上六点他终于出现了，带着两根鱼竿和一袋零食。
sentences.scene: 舅舅兑现带外甥钓鱼的承诺

sentences.english: My aunt sent me this necklace.
sentences.chinese: 这串项链是我姑姑送给我的。

sentences.english: I'm staying with my aunt for a few days while my parents are away.
sentences.chinese: 我爸妈出门这几天，我住在姑姑家。

sentences.english: My aunt always slips me extra dessert when she thinks my mom isn't looking, and it's been our little secret since I was a kid.
sentences.chinese: 我姑姑总是趁我妈不注意的时候多塞给我一份甜点，这是我们从我小时候就有的小秘密。
sentences.scene: 姑姑和孩子间的甜蜜小秘密

sentences.english: My apartment is pretty small.
sentences.chinese: 我的公寓非常小。

sentences.english: When I was small, I believed there were monsters under my bed.
sentences.chinese: 我很小的时候，相信床底下有怪物。

sentences.english: The coffee shop was tiny—only a small counter and two tables—but it had the best hot chocolate I'd ever tasted, so I went back every single day that winter.
sentences.chinese: 那家咖啡馆很小，只有一个不大的柜台和两张桌子，但有我喝过最美味的热巧克力，所以那年冬天我每天都去。
sentences.scene: 发现一家小而美的咖啡馆
